summary: The filing reports two routine items for CNL Strategic Residential Credit, Inc.: a first amendment to a $15 million revolving line of credit with Valley National Bank, allowing $5 million to be drawn for liquidity covenant compliance under repurchase agreements, and a monthly determination of net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026 (Class E: $25.23; Class FA: $24.92) with adjusted offering prices for private placements. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring is present. This is an ordinary current report on bank credit terms and NAV calculations.
